independent_cases: Seven canonically rewritten row corruptions (producer, attempt hash, target, reduction, identity, index, dtype) refuse complete-row reuse.
A second real OS process cannot take the same stable file lock while the writer is live and can acquire after release.
Crash after durable attempt publication is recovered as unknown exposure; a later complete producer remains distinct and aggregate totals preserve all attempts.
Changed adapter graph refuses namespace reuse even when every row is already complete.
Complete-file drift immediately before aggregate publication rejects without publishing output.
assessed_contract: Exact ordered prepared rows, masks, completeEOS, vocabulary/capacity and full conservative declared semantic identity are rebuilt rather than trusted as opaque JSON.
New rows cannot overwrite earlier receipts; attempt must originate from current writer; original producer/attempt/row bindings remain preserved across resumed assembly.
Stable flock spans scan, scoring interface and publication; complete-file drift and context checks precede each exclusive durable link; row itself is atomic completion.

Complete aggregation recomputes one flattened binary64 math.fsum over ordered per-token NLL; macro row mean is separate. Ordered hash descriptors retain occurrence, row,scope,shape,dtype andbyteorder.
All-complete path requires no scorer/model callable; isolated author test forbids MLX imports; actual workflow callers must preserve this path when integrated.
limitations: Approval is for an opt-in stdlib receipt ledger, not actual evaluation resume or a workflow/SFT feature. No existing evaluation job was changed.

Caller verify_context must validate actual underlying base/runtime/adapter/device/arithmetic evidence. A callback returning an expected digest alone is not verification; hashes and producer fields are assertions rather than process/model attestation.

Future integration needs actual score-one-row materialization, multi-producer SFT validation, composed project/lock/train-first/all-complete tests and real-model fresh-versus-resumed numerical qualification.
Advisory locking assumes cooperating callers and private ledger ownership; no hostile-process attestation is claimed.
Attempt/adoption counters are local to this progress namespace, not global heldout exposure accounting.
The v2 metric and ordered digest are deliberately different from historical FP32/blockwise reduction and concatenated-logits hash; no historical bitwise equivalence claim.
